purpose: Provide stable, purpose-labeled Production Atlas destinations for Crew Blueprint without copying volatile employer, opportunity, market, vacancy, pay, labor-route, or personal application data into curriculum.
rules: Crew Blueprint stores stable route identifiers and URLs only; Production Atlas owns volatile work intelligence.
A department-path experience classification is not a vacancy-level qualification claim.
Current vacancy requirements must be verified in Production Atlas against the current public posting or authoritative source.
No private application state, personal contacts, worker records, pay intelligence, or Roadmapdev private evidence may be copied through this registry.
If a Production Atlas route changes, update this registry and compatibility check rather than embedding repository branch paths in learner pages.
